configurations.name: Launch IlyPhoto.Api (Minimal API Microservice)
configurations.command: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$sdk = if (Test-Path '$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Microsoft\dotnet\dotnet.exe') { '$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Microsoft\dotnet\dotnet.exe' } else { 'dotnet' }; & $sdk run --project backend/IlyPhoto.Api/IlyPhoto.Api.csproj --urls http://localhost:5233"
